mapper.insert: insert into values(#{policy.tenantId},#{policy.policyId},#{policy.policyCode},#{policy.policyName},#{policy.sourceDomainId},#{policy.sourceDepartmentId},#{policy.sourceGroupId},#{policy.sourceAgentPoolId},#{policy.sourceAgentId},#{policy.targetDomainId},#{policy.targetDepartmentId},#{policy.targetGroupId},#{policy.targetAgentPoolId},#{policy.governanceOwnerDepartmentId},#{policy.governanceOwnerGroupId},#{policy.governanceScopeClass},#{policy.governanceScopeStatus},cast(#{policy.allowedTaskTypesJson} as jsonb),cast(#{policy.allowedServiceCodesJson} as jsonb),cast(#{policy.allowedCapabilityCodesJson} as on conflict(tenant_id,policy_id) do update set mapper.select: select * from a2a_policies where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and policy_id=#{policyId}

select * from a2a_policies where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and upper(source_domain_id)=upper(#{sourceDomainId}) and upper(target_domain_id)=upper(#{targetDomainId}) and enabled=true and (effective_at is null or effective_at <= #{at}) and (expires_at is null or expires_at > #{at}) order by policy_code
